# Election data test fixtures

`mit-nc-alamance-2024.tab` is a verbatim excerpt (header plus original lines 10472-10484)
of MIT Election Data and Science Lab, *County Presidential Election Returns 2000-2024*,
Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/VOQCHQ, version 20260225, released under CC0 1.0.
It is a real example of four unlabeled blank-mode rows per candidate.

Every other election-data fixture is synthetic and generated by
`tests/election_data_support.py`: geometry, counts, FEC and NARA layouts are invented to
exercise contracts and adversarial cases. Synthetic fixtures establish only synthetic
contracts; they are not election results.
